scope: R4 public workflow intake for selected observational method input; architecture choice only
question: Which representation should carry a generic R4 method's selected observational input from public workflow HTTP intake to the existing method-owner parser?

options.name: Typed selected ArtifactRef plus existing method-owner raw parser
options.recommendation: Preferred only if G confirms candidate-only legacy/unversioned intake creates no new authority or scientific semantics and specifies the legacy window, canonical source intent, selected method identity, and fail-closed present-invalid behavior.
options.tradeoff: Smallest reuse-first bridge; schema:null remains explicitly limited and lacks a versioned producer contract.

options.name: Versioned ObservationMethodInputEnvelope with real HTE target/producer/reader migration
options.recommendation: Choose if G requires versioned method input at this boundary; define actual HTE target/producer/migration before implementation.
options.tradeoff: Stronger explicit contract, but expands IR/schema/producer/reader/migration/generated-surface work.

options.name: Existing Ukraine/panel binder
options.recommendation: Reject as universal route; retain only for its purpose-specific panel contract.
options.tradeoff: Narrower domain semantics do not cover generic HTE/policy method input.
